title: 5.11.9 Lab: Sound effects
description: The game gets sound. Load a sound once in setup(), then play it from inside methods you already wrote: a zap from the Bullet constructor for every shot, and a boom from takeHit() for every enemy a shot finishes. A mute key is optional.

steps.title: Load two sounds
steps.instructions:
The game in the editor is your 5.11.6 game; it plays exactly as before, with no sound. Each step below teaches what it asks for.

`loadSound(path)` downloads a sound file and gives you back a **Sound** object. Keep it in a variable, the way you keep a sprite. The course has two sound files, and the path is typed exactly, quotes included: `'/moshion/assets/coin.wav'` is a short blip, and `'/moshion/assets/music.wav'` is a five-second tune. A misspelled path shows no error; the sound just never plays.

**Load once, in `setup()`; play later.** A file has to download before it can play, and a `.play()` that comes before the download finishes does nothing at all. So load each sound once in `setup()`. Loading in `draw()` or in a constructor would start a new download every time, and no `.play()` would ever be heard.

A Sound has two settings you can change, the way a sprite has `color`: `.volume` runs from `0` (silent) to `1` (full), and `.rate` is the playback speed, which changes the pitch too (`0.5` is slower and lower). That is how one file gives two sounds. Under the scene's other `let` lines add `let zap, boom;`, then in `setup()`, after `new Canvas(400, 400);`:

```js
zap = loadSound('/moshion/assets/coin.wav');
zap.volume = 0.3;    // shots come often, so keep them quiet
boom = loadSound('/moshion/assets/coin.wav');
boom.rate = 0.5;     // the same blip, slower and lower
```
hints: Type the path exactly as shown, quotes included. A misspelled path gives no error; the sound just never plays.
Load in setup() only. Anywhere that runs again and again would download the file again and again, and it would never be ready in time.

steps.title: A shot makes a sound
steps.instructions:
`zap.play();` plays the sound once, from the start. Every call starts a fresh copy, so two shots close together give two zaps that overlap instead of one cutting the other off.

A sound belongs in the one place where its event happens **exactly once**. `fire()` makes every shot with `new Bullet(...)`, so `Bullet`'s constructor runs once for every shot and at no other time. Add `zap.play();` as the last line of that constructor. (`draw()` would be wrong: it runs 60 times a second.)

A browser makes no sound until the player has pressed a key or clicked the page. moSHion switches sound on at the first key press, and in Defender the first sound is a shot, which needs Space, so this never gets in your way. Run, click the game so it gets your keys, and hold Space: one zap per shot.
hints: Nothing to hear? Click the game before pressing Space, and check that the browser tab and your speakers are not muted.

steps.title: A finished enemy makes a sound
steps.instructions:
Every hit calls `takeHit(1)`, so `takeHit` runs once per hit. In `Enemy`'s `takeHit(n)`, after the line that shows the new hp, add:

```js
if (!this.isAlive()) boom.play();
```

The enemy asks itself the question the scene asks, and plays only on the hit that left it with no hp. Not in `isAlive()` itself: that is asked many times every frame, so a sound there would play over and over. Play a round: an orange 3-hp enemy booms once, on its third hit, and an enemy that reaches the base makes no sound.
hints: `takeHit` runs once for every hit. The `if` keeps the boom for the one hit that left the enemy with no hp.

steps.title: Optional: a mute key
hints: `masterVolume()` with nothing in the brackets reads the level now; `masterVolume(0)` and `masterVolume(1)` set it.

requirements.title: Sounds are loaded once, in setup()
requirements.description: setup() loads a sound into a variable with loadSound and the path '/moshion/assets/coin.wav' (or music.wav), so it is ready before the game needs it. Any variable name works. Help: step 1 of this lab.
requirements.hint: Check the path letter by letter: '/moshion/assets/coin.wav'. And load it in setup(), not in draw() or a constructor.

requirements.title: A shot makes a sound
requirements.description: A sound's .play() runs once for every shot: in Bullet's constructor, or right beside new Bullet(...) in fire(). Help: 5.11.5 (Lab: Bullet, and a hit that takes an enemy)
requirements.hint: Bullet's constructor runs once per shot, so its last line is the place for .play().

requirements.title: A finished enemy makes a sound
requirements.description: A sound's .play() runs when a shot finishes an enemy: in Enemy's takeHit(), or under an if that asks the enemy isAlive() or about its hp. Help: 5.11.4 (Lab: Enemy takes over)
requirements.hint: In takeHit(), after the hp line: if (!this.isAlive()) then play the sound.
